faqs.question: What does ketoconazole shampoo do for your hair?

faqs.question: Can I use ketoconazole shampoo everyday?
faqs.answer: No, Ketoconazole shampoo should not be used everyday as daily application may harm the hair. Use Ketoconazole shampoo twice to thrice a week, regularly.

faqs.question: Is ketoconazole a steroid?

faqs.answer: Man Matters Ketoconazole shampoo is safe for hair and its optimal dosage has no side effects.
